snippet.title: BULLETJUMP – Official Gameplay Trailer | Bullet-Hell Platformer
snippet.description:
Jump, shoot, dodge and survive in BULLETJUMP, a precision bullet-hell platformer where every movement matters.

Navigate increasingly intense projectile patterns, destroy incoming bullets, collect powerful upgrades and use split-second movement to keep your run alive. Compete for high scores, tackle daily challenges and race against other players using their exact run seeds.

BULLETJUMP features:
- Fast, precision-based jumping and shooting
- Escalating bullet-hell survival runs
- Destructible enemy projectiles
- Abilities, shields and gameplay-changing power-ups
- Global and friends leaderboards
- Daily challenges with unique modifiers
- Full-fidelity leaderboard replays
- Seed challenges against other players
- Steam achievements and career statistics

Wishlist BULLETJUMP on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4038280/BULLETJUMP/

BULLETJUMP is currently in active development.
